about: The offertorium of the formulary “Palm Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: My heart has expected reproach and misery; and I looked for one who would grieve together with me, but there was none; I sought one who would comfort me, and I found none; and they gave me gall for my food, and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

a.g: they gave me vinegar to drink
